integrity_statement: An exact finite-weight Fourier proof establishes every claimed inequality; 9,681 rational checks are auxiliary and are not a substitute for the universal argument. Independent priority and validation remain unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Common Bernoulli bias and finite positive integer weights. The result concerns order-two Renyi entropy and does not imply Shannon entropy concavity, Renyi-2 concavity in bias, or an optimal fixed-length envelope. A general earlier spectral result could subsume the polynomial representation.
title: Complete collision-profile positivity for overlapping Bernoulli sums
